scope_summary.value: Emergency power backup for the entirety of Buildings 500 and 501 at HHM VAMC Richmond — upstream of the main switchgear at the 13.2kV system, with 20% future load growth. Caterpillar generators with new paralleling switchgear (ASCO 7000-series transfer switch line). New medium-voltage (MV) transfer switch, MV duct bank with concrete encasement, load bank, new generator pads, civil site work (grading, sanitary sewer relocation, E&S control, landscaping), and structural pad/foundation design. Design shall comply with N+1 redundancy for emergency power systems and coordination with Dominion Power for Level 3 soft-closed transitions interconnection.
